finding_status.notes: Fix (a) applied as the user chose. src/codemie/configs/managed_mcp_config.py now defines _use_default_if_none raising PydanticUseDefault when the value is None, and callback_host is Annotated[str, BeforeValidator(_use_default_if_none)] = Field(default='localhost', alias='callbackHost') — so an explicitly blank YAML key resolves to the documented default rather than raising and dropping the whole entry. PydanticUseDefault was chosen over returning a literal so 'localhost' stays defined once, on the Field. Regression test test_blank_callback_host_falls_back_to_default asserts both [s.name] == ['blank_host'] (entry survives) and callback_host == 'localhost' (default applied); it was observed failing with assert [] == ['blank_host'] before the fix.
